NEOW.talk.AK_EXUSIAI_CHARACTER_EXUSIAI.0:
[sine]...wake... shining... messenger...
...go up... kill... the Architect...[/sine]

Wow, you've even filled in the recipient?
I'd still like to know what I'm delivering.
I'll take the blessing. As for who gets shot, I'll see for myself.
NEOW.talk.AK_EXUSIAI_CHARACTER_EXUSIAI.1:
Can't have everyone worrying the moment they see me, can I?
Come on, let's try a different route!
NEOW.talk.AK_EXUSIAI_CHARACTER_EXUSIAI.2:
[sine]...I can... make you... forget...
...all that... pain...[/sine]
Would I forget my sister, my friends, and my promises too?
I'll pass. It's a heavy load, but I'm not throwing out the names on the parcels.
DARV.talk.AK_EXUSIAI_CHARACTER_EXUSIAI.0: Hey, glow-top! Lookin' for somethin'? I've got a bit of everything!

Gun parts, records, and a crate big enough for both!
Could you use a logistics consultant?
A consultant? Don't go movin' my treasures around to suit some system!
Got it. A mysterious filing system maintained by the boss himself. I know the type.
DARV.talk.AK_EXUSIAI_CHARACTER_EXUSIAI.1: Back again? Good stuff in that crate! Uh... or maybe the next one!
No problem. I've got plenty of practice tracking down missing parcels.
DARV.talk.AK_EXUSIAI_CHARACTER_EXUSIAI.2: Nobody wants this old stuff anymore, but you're sure diggin' through it!

Old doesn't mean useless.
Sometimes you keep a record because of who you used to play it with.
Ha! You get it, girl! Can't just throw that away!
Then rest easy. Whatever I pick is coming with me to be used, not sold for pocket change.
NONUPEIPE.talk.AK_EXUSIAI_CHARACTER_EXUS: What exquisite luminous adornments! A pity you pair them with traveling clothes.

Thanks! I can run and jump in these, and the pockets fit my magazines.
Any alterations have to keep the pockets.
Utility... Such a limited ambition. Come closer. Let me improve your taste.
Then let's show the Spire what a truly dazzling courier looks like!
Covered in dust again? My blessings were not meant to be buried in grime.
They've all had front-row seats. I haven't left a single one at the bottom of a crate.
With my gifts, you should be looked up to. Yet you still mingle with the crowd?
If I'm too far away to see who's laughing, what's the point of a party?
At least ensure they understand how fortunate they are.
Sure. I'm pretty lucky too, getting a seat at their table.
OROBAS.talk.AK_EXUSIAI_CHARACTER_EXUSIAI:
Shiny ring! Floating! How?!
Can touch? Can take?!

Whoa, that one's not for giving away! I haven't even found its switch.
Want a closer look at my badge instead?

Tiny! Shiny! Good thing!
I have things too! Look, look!
Sure did! This one starts with a concert that nearly took the roof off.
Don't break roof! Do tell story!

You have weapon too! Fight Architect?
Don't fight! Talking good!

I like a job where we can sit down and talk.
But what if he won't listen, and starts hurting people?
All right, I'll call out first. If that saves the bullets, you get a whole evening of stories.
PAEL.talk.AK_EXUSIAI_CHARACTER_EXUSIAI.0:
[thinky_dots]That light... rather bright.
Have you come for a part of me too...?[/thinky_dots]

Sorry, I'll stand to the side.
But does it really not hurt?

[thinky_dots]Sleep... and it grows back.
Take it. May your road be easier...[/thinky_dots]
Thank you. I'll keep my voice down. Sweet dreams.
PAEL.talk.AK_EXUSIAI_CHARACTER_EXUSIAI.1: A little farther to go. You sleep. I'll turn the radio down.
PAEL.talk.AK_EXUSIAI_CHARACTER_EXUSIAI.2:
[thinky_dots]If you see Father...
Tell him I am still here...[/thinky_dots]
[thinky_dots]Even... if you go to hurt him...?[/thinky_dots]

I'll stop him if I have to.
But he ought to know someone's waiting for him.
TANX.talk.AK_EXUSIAI_CHARACTER_EXUSIAI.0: WARRIOR OF LIGHT! HOW MANY WEAPONS HAVE YOU BROUGHT!!
Enough for trouble on the road. Not nearly enough for my collection!
GOOD ANSWER!! TAKE MORE! THEN FIGHT ME!!
Ground rules first: nobody stands downrange. That includes you!
TANX.talk.AK_EXUSIAI_CHARACTER_EXUSIAI.1: You noticed? Pretty good rhythm today, huh?
TANX.talk.AK_EXUSIAI_CHARACTER_EXUSIAI.2: EXUSIAI! NO MORE TARGET PRACTICE! FIGHT ME!!
You're on, but just a spar! I've still got deliveries.
[i][font_size=22]Exusiai empties her magazine amid thunder and laughter.[/font_size][/i]
EXCELLENT!! BUT YOU'RE TOO QUIET WHEN YOU RELOAD!!
TEZCATARA.talk.AK_EXUSIAI_CHARACTER_EXUS:
Oh, sweetheart, you've brought the light in with you.
Shall I add a little [jitter][b]fire[/b][/jitter]?
Sounds good! There's ammunition in my bag, though. Let's agree on the temperature first.
Don't fret, dear. I know just how to care for little [jitter][b]flammable[/b][/jitter] things.
Traveling on an empty stomach again? Come here. I've prepared something [jitter][b]warm[/b][/jitter].
Any apple pie? Ah, hang on. I'd better check that filling.
What a sweet smile. Let me [jitter][b]burn away[/b][/jitter] whatever makes you sad.
Better not. Some things hurt to remember, but I still need to remember them.
Can't let go? That will keep [jitter][b]hurting[/b][/jitter], you know.

That's what dinner and music with friends are for.
Let's keep the oven for supper.
An angel stands before me. What would you trade for my power?

Price first, terms second.
And make the fine print as big as the heading, please.
A cautious courier. Understanding a contract does not make it merciful.
Better than signing and finding out I've inherited somebody else's debts. Let's see it.
You need me again. That halo has spared you none of the price, has it?
It's not a discount voucher. All right, what are the terms this time?
You pray to a god that does not answer, yet seek power from a demon. How touching.
God isn't the only one on my mind when I pray.
Your friends? I could put them in the contract too.
Then we have no deal. I sign for myself. Their lives aren't part of the price.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.AK_EXUSIAI_CHARACTER_: Another halo come to pronounce judgment?

Exusiai. Courier.
Though I do have questions about what I've seen on the way.
I owe Neow's puppets no explanation.

Then look at me, not the halo.
I'm the one standing here. The one deciding to pull the trigger.
Back again. Do you still not understand the order of this place?
I've seen it. Funny how the people paying the price never seem to get a say.
So you will make noise on their behalf?
Hey, I am pretty loud. At least yours won't be the only voice in here.
You cannot save everyone. How many times must we repeat this?

Never took on a job that big.
But the people I meet on the road? I've got to try.
You're not the only one who gets a say in that.
